operations.heading: /{threads-user-id}/threads
operations.summary: Upload media and create media containers. See Posts for more information.

params.name: threads-user-id
params.description: The path parameter of the Threads user identifier.

params.name: media_type
params.description: The type of media container to create. Values: `TEXT`, `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, `CAROUSEL`

params.name: text
params.description: The text associated with the post. Uses UTF-8 encoding. Required for text-only posts. Note: For the post character limit, emojis are counted as the number of UTF-8 bytes.

params.name: image_url
params.description: The public URL of the image. Required if `media_type=IMAGE`.

params.name: video_url
params.description: The public URL of the video. Required if `media_type=VIDEO`.

params.name: is_made_with_ai
params.description: Set to `true` to disclose that a post contains AI-generated content and display the AI info label. Supported for `TEXT`, `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, and `CAROUSEL` posts. Values: `true`, `false` (default) Set this parameter when creating the media container, not when calling `POST /{threads-user-id}/threads_publish`. For carousels, set it on the parent container. Setting `is_made_with_ai=true` on an individual carousel item (`is_carousel_item=true`) returns an error. Omitting this parameter or setting it to `false` does not add an AI self-disclosure. It does not prevent automatic AI labeling. See Label AI-generated content for an example.

params.name: is_carousel_item
params.description: Set to `true` if this container is an item in a carousel. Values: `true`, `false` (default)

params.name: children
params.description: A comma-separated list of the media container IDs of the carousel items. Required if `media_type=CAROUSEL`.

params.name: reply_to_id
params.description: The ID of the post to reply to. Required if replying to a post.

params.name: reply_control
params.description: Specifies who can reply to the post. Values: `everyone`, `accounts_you_follow`, `mentioned_only`, `parent_post_author_only`, `followers_only`

params.name: allowlisted_country_codes
params.description: A list of valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that represents the countries where this media should be shown. If this parameter is passed in, the media is not shown to Threads profiles in countries outside of this list.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: The accessibility text label or description for an image or video in a Threads post. Note: The maximum length of `alt_text` is 1,000 characters.

params.name: link_attachment
params.description: The URL attached to a Threads post.

params.name: quote_post_id
params.description: ID of the post to quote.

params.name: poll_attachment
params.description: The options for a post with a poll attachment.

params.name: auto_publish_text
params.description: When set to `true`, a Threads post is published automatically when a Threads media container is created without needing to go through the extra publish step. Note: This only works for text posts.

params.name: topic_tag
params.description: The topic to add to a post. Note: The following characters are not allowed in topic tags: Periods (.) Ampersands (&)

params.name: is_spoiler_media
params.description: Whether the media should be a spoiler. Values: `true`, `false`

params.name: text_entities
params.description: The spoiler settings for the post.

params.name: text_attachment
params.description: The text attachment for the post.

params.name: gif_attachment
params.description: The ID and GIF provider for the GIF to attach to the post. Fields: `gif_id`, `provider`

params.name: is_ghost_post
params.description: Whether the post is a ghost post. Values: `true`, `false`

params.name: enable_reply_approvals
params.description: Whether the post should have reply approvals enabled. Values: `true`, `false`

params.name: crossreshare_to_ig
params.description: Cross-shares a Threads post to a linked Instagram account as a Story when set to `true`. Values: `true`, `false` (default)

params.name: crossreshare_to_ig_dark_mode
params.description: Cross-shares a Threads post to a linked Instagram account as a Story in dark mode when set to `true`. Values: `true`, `false` (default)

params.name: location_id
params.description: The ID of the location to tag. Note: Use the `GET /location_search` endpoint to find location IDs.

operations.heading: /keyword_search
operations.summary: Search for public Threads media with specific keywords or topic tags. See Keyword search for more information.

params.name: q
params.description: The keyword or keywords to search for.

params.name: search_type
params.description: Specifies the search behavior. Values: `TOP` (default) — Returns the most popular search results. `RECENT` — Returns the most recent search results.

params.name: search_mode
params.description: Specifies the search mode. Values: `KEYWORD` (default) — The query is treated as a keyword. `TAG` — The query is treated as a topic tag.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Specifies the type of media to search for. Only the media type values listed below are supported. Values: `TEXT` — The query searches for text posts. `IMAGE` — The query searches for image posts. `VIDEO` — The query searches for video posts.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of the fields to be returned. Values: `id` (default), `media_product_type`, `media_type`, `media_url`, `permalink`, `username`, `text`, `timestamp`, `shortcode`, `thumbnail_url`, `children`, `is_quote_post`, `alt_text`, `link_attachment_url`, `has_replies`, `is_reply`, `root_post`, `replied_to`, `reply_audience`, `quoted_post`, `reposted_post`, `gif_url`, `poll_attachment`, `topic_tag`

params.name: since
params.description: The start date for retrieval, as a Unix timestamp (such as `1767225600`) or a date (such as `2026-01-01`). Must be on or after `1688540400` and before `until`.

params.name: until
params.description: The end date for retrieval, as a Unix timestamp (such as `1767225600`) or a date (such as `2026-01-01`). Must be after `since` and no later than the current time.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of media objects or records to return. The default is `25` and the maximum is `100`. Only non-negative numbers are allowed.

params.name: author_username
params.description: Filters search results to include only posts created by the specified username. The username must be an exact match without the `@` symbol.

operations.heading: /oembed?url=...
operations.summary: Retrieve the embed HTML code snippet and metadata of a post or profile.

params.name: url
params.description: Permanent link to the post or profile on Threads. Accepted formats: `https://www.threads.com/@{username}/post/{media-shortcode}` `https://www.threads.com/t/{media-shortcode}` `https://www.threads.com/@{username}` Examples: https://www.threads.com/@meta/post/DDzbnVKx57R https://www.threads.com/t/DDzbnVKx57R https://www.threads.com/@meta

params.name: maxwidth
params.description: Maximum width of returned media. Must be between 320 and 658 pixels. Note: The `maxheight` parameter is not supported because the embed code is responsive and its height varies depending on its width.

params.name: theme
params.description: Display mode for the embed. Accepted values: `light`: Always use light mode. This is the default if you omit `theme`. `dark`: Always use dark mode. `auto`: Automatically use light or dark mode based on the viewer's preferred appearance settings.

described.threads_basic: Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.

described.threads_manage_replies: Required for creating replies with the `reply_to_id` parameter.

described.threads_read_replies: Required for making `GET` calls to reply endpoints.
